decisions: Inspected all 17 worker merges, all 37 arguments' routes and seven substantive edits. Accepted the generic committee-report Tolerance retirement; retired three isolated-harm/Societal relabelings and generic religious privacy-as-Tradition. Collision-risk possibility is qualified context. The education/health benefit route does not require the fairness premise; fairness, changing-space coverage and enforcement facts are local when only one user remains. Kept bodily-check pressure as the sole shared judgment, with record-based alternatives and independent routes visible.
source_context_read: Bill text; World Rugby modeling, international scope and domestic flexibility; 2024 athlete study policy passage and mixed measures; 2026 review abstract/correction limits; Hecox state-law comparison and invasive-check procedure; Societal Security definition; religious resolution privacy passage. All were existing packet text, with targeted context rather than a new exhaustive evidence review.

substantive_edits.reason: Clarity: terms explained. Factual correction in the response: the unsupported paraphrase that the athlete study’s authors call it ‘not sufficient to guide policy’ was replaced by their exact sentence on sports-specific studies, after reading the study’s policy passage.

Clarity: terms explained. Added qualification in the response: its advantage premise is disputed, with an exact quotation from the 2026 review already cited on this page. Without it the response cited 2021 evidence alone. Limits on its reach are preserved.

Clarity: terms explained. Added context: World Rugby’s stated international-level scope and flexibility for national bodies, with exact quotations from the World Rugby news release already cited here, because this argument applies that conclusion to covered U.S. school competition.

Clarity: JV, varsity and CDC explained. Narrowed wording in the response: ‘the roster example’ and ‘the evidence does not supply’ now refer to the evidence given, so the response does not read as demanding a named case; its stated limit is kept.
Clarity: terms explained. Substantive surfacing: the separate route already named in the reviewed response is now stated in the PRO so that the two texts agree; no new evidence or argument was added.
